name: Fonts In Use
summary: Searchable archive of 34,773 typographic designs, each documented with images and indexed by typeface, format and topic.
description: An independent, community-contributed archive of typography in the wild: album art, magazines, signs, logos, identities, books and websites, each entry credited to its designer and contributor. Typeface pages add foundry, designer and release-date data plus where to get the fonts, and the whole collection is searchable and filterable by typeface, format and topic.
contains: indexed by typeface, format (magazine, album art, logo, sign, website) and 30 topics
typeface pages list foundry, designers, release date, related typefaces and where to get the fonts
community-contributed entries with credits and images
advanced search plus sort by contribution date, artwork date, most discussed, most liked or most viewed
